sources.covers: the included diverging lenses (35°, 60°, 80°) and the optional 120° lens

note: An 850 nm IR LED illuminator ("Type 850 nm semi-covert"; wavelength_nm 850). Angle "Without diverging lenses: 10°", "With diverging lenses: 35°, 60°, 80°, 120°" (beam_deg 10 is the standard lens, 10° × 10°; the diverging lenses are not round: 35° x 10°, 60° x 25°, 80° x 30°, 120° x 50°). Distance "With standard lens 10° x 10°: 144 m", 35° x 10°: 78 m, 60° x 25°: 54 m, 80° x 30°: 36 m, 120° x 50°: 24 m (a camera illumination range, not an irradiance). Power: AC/DC variant "Maximum light: 18 W" (power_w 18), PoE variant 20 W. Dimensions "100 x 135 x 66 mm" (size_mm null: the axes are not named), weight "950 g". IEC/EN 62471 risk group 2. Not stated: the radiant power or irradiance (ir_irradiance_w_m2 null), so the lighting study's IR check cannot use it until a measured figure is entered.
interface: AC/DC 12-24 V or PoE (IEEE 802.3at Type 2 Class 4)
